Add to Cart

Our reimagined classic. We spike our cream with just enough Guatemalan fleur de sel to bring out its nuances and then drizzle in ribbons of our caramel.

Add to Cart

It's called "double fold" for a reason: Our friends at Singing Dog use twice as many vanilla beans in their extract to pack a craveable punch.
